name: Cart Wishlist & Checkout
description: Verifies adding a product to cart updates the cart count, cart drawer opens, wishlist toggle works, and the checkout page renders with order summary and payment form.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Shop' link in the navigation
Click on the first product card
Click the 'Add to Cart' button on the product detail page
Verify a cart drawer or cart notification appears showing the added product
Click the heart/wishlist icon on the product detail page
Verify the heart icon changes state to indicate the product is wishlisted
Click the cart icon in the navigation bar to open the cart
Click the 'Checkout' or 'Proceed to Checkout' button
Verify the checkout page loads with an order summary section and a payment or contact information form
